title: Microwave-assisted fabrication of porous flower-like pseudo-boehmite and high-efficiency removal for phosphate from water: Batch and fixed-bed column continuous operation
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Accepted Manuscript
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW01071J, Paper
ruohui Du, Huiyu Li, Saeed Ahmed, Shaowei Shi, Yongjun Feng
It is of great interest and importance to explore low-cost and high-efficiency adsorbent for phosphate removal. Here, we developed a microwave-assisted hydrothermal method to fabricate three demension flower-like pseudo-boehmite adsorbents...
